cover.report_type: September 16 (interim); 'Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate'

_meta.notes: September 16, 2024 report on the 2024 'For a Candidate' form. Cover and Summary are handwritten; signature date handwritten '9-16-24'; the amendment question has NEITHER box checked. Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p6) are county stubs with 'See Attached' written across; the real lines are ruled LANDSCAPE spreadsheet exports stored rotated 90 deg in the PDF (read via clockwise rotation). C attachment columns: Donation Date / Net Amount / First Name / Last Name / Address Line 1 / Address Line 2 / City / State / Zip / Employer / Occupation - the bar covers Address Line 1 through Zip so no geography survives; names are split into First/Last cells and are emitted joined ('First Last'); organizations carry the full name in the First Name cell. E attachment columns: Date / Amount / Vendor Name / Description; every amount prints NEGATIVE and the printed TOTAL is -$38,490.71. Six C rows (69-74) are negative refund adjustments to Jeanette Bennett. E rows 35 and 74 are marked in-kind in the Description text and mirror C rows 56 and 76. Several Employer/vendor strings are clipped at the column right edge as printed (marked per row).
